initial:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite sheet for a side-scrolling 16-bit platformer.
Primary request: Create a clean, cohesive pixel-art sprite sheet of Abdul El-Sayed as the playable protagonist, with three complete animation cycles: idle, running, and casting his fictional "disavow" spell.
Subject: Recognizable Abdul El-Sayed, an adult Egyptian-American man with warm medium brown skin, very short dark hair, strong dark eyebrows, close-trimmed full dark beard and mustache, broad friendly face, athletic stocky build. Slightly enlarged expressive head for legibility. Light rolled-sleeve open-collar button-up shirt, dark trousers, dark shoes. No tie, no glasses, no weapons, no logos. Outfit and face identical in every frame.
Style/medium: authentic SNES / Sega-era hand-pixelled 16-bit platformer sprite art. Crisp square pixel clusters, limited opaque colors, dark one-pixel outlines, 2–3 shade ramps, readable silhouette. Character about 52 source-pixels tall, enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels. No anti-aliasing, no smooth illustration, no 3D, no soft shadows.
Composition/framing: ONE uniform sprite atlas, landscape 2:1 canvas, exactly SIX columns and THREE rows, 18 equal square cells. Every cell contains exactly one full-body character. Transparent background everywhere outside sprites. NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text, NO headings. Each cell is the same size. Consistent character height, head size, ground baseline, lighting, and feet origin. Character facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view in all 18 frames. Generous transparent gutter, with all action contained inside its own cell. Never clip hands, feet or effects. Treat each row as six consecutive temporal frames of ONE animation, no alternate character designs.
Top row IDLE, six distinct frames: neutral ready stance; slight inhale; shoulders rise; weight settles; small blink; return to neutral. Subtle restrained motion, feet planted at same baseline.
Middle row RUN, six distinct frames in an actual full looping run cycle: right foot contact with left arm forward; recoil/down; right-leg passing with left knee lifting; left foot contact with right arm forward; recoil/down; left-leg passing with right knee lifting. Alternate the front and back leg, use readable strides, opposite arms, slight forward lean and small vertical bob.
Bottom row DISAVOW CAST, six distinct frames: neutral ready; pull right hand back to chest in anticipation; brace feet and gather a compact magical spark; thrust open right palm to the right in a clear emphatic rejection gesture; release a crisp angular magical shockwave with a few opaque pixel sparks toward the right, kept within the cell; retract and recover toward idle. The magic is a clean bright pixel burst, not fire, smoke or text. Human anatomy stays coherent, the casting hand has a readable open-palm silhouette. No wand, no wizard costume, no speech bubble. Keep effects beside the hand rather than covering the face.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background; individual visible pixels fully opaque; 18 frames in the exact 6-by-3 arrangement; no background scenery; no floor; no cast shadow; no captions; no checkerboard printed into the image; no duplicate people within any cell.
refinement:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent 16-bit platformer sprite atlas.
Edit target: the supplied Abdul El-Sayed sprite sheet.
Primary request: Final production cleanup of this exact sprite sheet, retaining this character design and these eighteen animation poses.
Preserve: the same recognizable face, short dark hair, beard, skin tone, light rolled-sleeve shirt, dark trousers and shoes; same six idle poses, six running poses, six disavow spell poses; all face right; preserve the personality and readable palm-out spell gesture.
Change only technical sprite rendering and spacing: rebuild on a perfectly regular SIX-column THREE-row grid with equal SQUARE cells. Target output 1536 by 768 pixels, with each of the eighteen cells 256 by 256 pixels. In every cell put the character's standing ground origin at x=96, y=232 relative to the cell. Character is about 192 pixels tall, constructed in exact crisp 4-by-4 pixel blocks as if drawn at 48-pixel height then enlarged nearest-neighbor. Keep every character frame at exactly the same scale and align the body core to the same origin. Leave transparent margins at every outside image edge; no sprite may touch the image boundary.
Eliminate all stray colored edge pixels, ghost fringes, partially transparent fills, glows and soft shading. STRICT BINARY ALPHA: pixels are either fully transparent or fully opaque, including all spell pixels. All visible pixel clusters have solid edges. Spell effect consists of compact opaque bright cyan and white angular pixels, no transparent haze or blur. Spell and extended hand entirely fit inside their individual frame, never spill into an adjacent cell. Make the burst compact enough that the fifth casting cell does not overlap the sixth. Maintain same planted-foot baseline in the entire casting row; last frame returns to the idle pose.
Keep background genuinely transparent. No checkerboard texture, no floor, no grid, no labels, no text or watermark. Do not add new designs or extra characters.
note: The generator returned 1774 × 887 pixels; use atlas.json rectangles rather than an assumed uniform grid.
